lazy_chunks.screen.title: LazyChunks
lazy_chunks.option.lazy_chunk_loading.to: Spreads chunk packet work across multiple frames to reduce stutters.
lazy_chunks.option.target_fps.name: Target FPS
lazy_chunks.option.target_fps.tooltip: Baseline FPS used for chunk budget scaling.
lazy_chunks.option.fps_threshold.name: FPS Threshold
lazy_chunks.option.fps_threshold.tooltip: Disables throttling when 1% low FPS is above this value.
lazy_chunks.option.base_weight.name: Base Weight
lazy_chunks.option.base_weight.tooltip: Chunk weight processed per frame at the target FPS.
lazy_chunks.option.max_frame_time.name: Max Frame Time
lazy_chunks.option.max_frame_time.toolti: Maximum frame time percentage spent on chunk tasks.
Reduces chunk work when frame times become unstable.
lazy_chunks.option.teleport_protection.t: Uses a conservative budget after teleporting or changing dimensions.
lazy_chunks.option.minimum_budget.name: Minimum Budget
lazy_chunks.option.minimum_budget.toolti: Minimum chunk weight budget processed each frame.
lazy_chunks.option.dynamic_core.name: Dynamic Core
lazy_chunks.option.dynamic_core.tooltip: Adds virtual chunk budget cores when 1% low FPS is poor but normal FPS has headroom.
lazy_chunks.option.dynamic_low_threshold: 1% low FPS threshold used to detect sustained chunk loading pressure.
How long 1% low FPS must stay below the threshold before extra cores are added.
lazy_chunks.option.dynamic_average_fps_t: Normal FPS must be above this value before dynamic cores can be added.
Extra normal FPS required for each additional virtual core.
lazy_chunks.option.dynamic_max_extra_cor: Maximum number of virtual cores that dynamic core can add.
lazy_chunks.option.dynamic_core_decrease: How many virtual cores are removed at each check when FPS falls back.
lazy_chunks.option.dynamic_weight_per_co: Extra chunk weight budget provided by each virtual core.
lazy_chunks.option.show_debug_overlay.to: Shows LazyChunks diagnostics in the F3 debug overlay.
